In search of GBS-specific markers, we first compared the NCIC 11168 patterns with the AFLP patterns of the genetically related GBS-associated strain GB11. However, although NCTC 11168 was originally isolated from the faeces of a patient with gastroenteritis, we cannot exclude that NCTC 11168 can induce CBS if a patient with the right host susceptibility faators becomes infected with this strain. The only substantial but probably very important difference between NCIC 11168 and CB11 that has been found so far, is that the LOS biosynthesis gene locus strongly diverges between these strains, probably as result of a horizontal exchange event 32].
